title: PNOC 8/9: Gauquelin sector rise/set methods (swe_gauquelin_sector imeth 2–5 + full dispatcher)
description:
### Summary
Complete the `swe_gauquelin_sector` port: implement the rise/set-based methods (imeth 2–5) on top of the existing `Ephemeris::rise_trans`, and expose a full dispatcher `Ephemeris::gauquelin_sector` that routes imeth 0/1 to the already-ported geometric method and 2–5 to the new one. Note the C doc-comment only describes imeth 0–3; imeth 4/5 (disc-edge variants) exist in the code and MUST be included.

Read `docs/codebase-map.md` FIRST, then `docs/c-ref-gauquelin-riseset.md` in full. Do NOT read the C source.

### Files
- `src/context.rs` — new private `gauquelin_sector_risetrans(...)` method + public `Ephemeris::gauquelin_sector(t_ut, body, flags, imeth, geopos, atpress, attemp) -> Result<f64, Error>` dispatcher; the existing `gauquelin_sector_geometric` becomes the imeth 0/1 arm (keep it public or fold it in — keep the existing name working since golden tests call it). If context.rs is getting crowded, a new `src/gauquelin.rs` module is acceptable ONLY if the geometric method moves too; otherwise stay in context.rs beside it.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_houses.c` — extend the existing `gauquelin_sector` battery generation with imeth 2–5 cases under a NEW key `gauquelin_riseset` (do not touch existing keys' case sets).
- `tests/golden-data/houses.json` — regenerated (existing keys must be byte-identical; only the new key added).
- `tests/golden/houses.rs` — new `gauquelin_riseset` test fn.

### Implementation steps
1. **Dispatcher** (doc §1–2): validate imeth 0..=5; imeth 0/1 → existing geometric path (delete its "not ported" Err arm); 2–5 → rise/set path. imeth semantics table (§2): 2 = disc-center + no refraction, 3 = disc-center + refraction, 4 = disc-edge + no refraction, 5 = disc-edge + refraction — each maps to specific `RiseSetFlags`/SE_BIT_* combinations on the rise_trans calls; take the exact bit sets from §2's table.
2. **epheflag/deltaT** (doc §4–5): extract epheflag from flags per §4; deltaT handling per §5 (note whether it's the caller-flag-carrying pattern like gauquelin_sector_geometric or the forced-TIDAL_DEFAULT pattern like houses_ex2 — the doc records which; follow it exactly, this distinction has bitten twice before, see sidereal_time.rs's codebase-map note).
3. **Rise/set search** (doc §7, subsections 7.1–7.4): the exact sequence — find next rise, find next set from t_ut, determine above/below horizon bracketing, and the re-search adjustment loops when t_ut isn't bracketed. PRESERVE the control-flow quirk §7 flags: the C pre-sets the OPPOSITE event's found-flag to TRUE before retrying a search and lets the retry's own circumpolar outcome overwrite it — restructure only in ways that provably keep the same outcomes (the doc explains which outcomes matter). Interpolation (§7.4): above horizon `(t − t_rise)/(t_set − t_rise) × 18 + 1`; below `(t − t_set)/(t_rise − t_set) × 18 + 19` — exact expressions from the doc.
4. **Circumpolar** (doc §8): `Ephemeris::rise_trans` returning `Err(Error::CircumpolarBody)` maps to C's retc −2 contract — propagate per §8 (gauquelin returns an error; never a fabricated sector).
5. **Fixed stars** (doc §6): our rise_trans has no fixed-star TOPOCTR support and star handling is untested (codebase-map riseset note). Implement the starname path only if `rise_trans` already accepts stars end-to-end; otherwise return the existing unsupported-star error and note it in the task close-out. Bodies Sun..TrueNode must work.
6. **atpress/attemp** (doc §3): pass through unmodified — defaulting happens inside rise_trans's resolve_atpress (already ported, src/azalt.rs:172); zero special-casing here.
7. **Golden harness**: extend gen_houses.c — new key `gauquelin_riseset`: reuse the existing 6 ut_triples × bodies {SE_SUN, SE_MOON, SE_MARS} × imeth {2, 3, 4, 5} with SEFLG_MOSEPH, atpress=0, attemp=0 (72 cases); record dgsect + retval (retval<0 cases assert Err in Rust — include at least the existing high-latitude triple so a circumpolar case is plausible; if none of the battery goes circumpolar, that's fine, the full test still locks the happy path). Regenerate houses.json and diff: existing keys byte-identical.
8. **Rust test**: dgsect eps 1e-6 (rise/set times feed a linear interpolation; rise_trans golden tolerance is 1e-6 day).

### C reference
`docs/c-ref-gauquelin-riseset.md` — all sections. §9 cross-references the geometric branch already ported (c-ref-houses.md §13 / context.rs).

### Golden tests
- Rebuild gen_houses + regenerate: `cc -O2 -I../swisseph -o tests/c-gen/gen_houses tests/c-gen/gen_houses.c -L../swisseph -lswe -lm && ./tests/c-gen/gen_houses > tests/golden-data/houses.json`
- `cargo test --test golden houses -- --nocapture` (all existing house tests must still pass — the regeneration must not disturb existing keys)

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden houses -- --nocapture` passes including the new gauquelin_riseset fn (~72 cases).
- Existing houses.json keys byte-identical after regeneration (verify with git diff / jq).
- `cargo test` full suite passes; no new clippy warnings.
- Update `docs/codebase-map.md` (context.rs gauquelin entry + gen_houses/houses.json/houses.rs entries).

### Escape hatch
If golden tests fail with sector errors > 1e-5 after two debugging attempts, STOP and report: which cases fail, actual vs expected, what you tried. Do not exceed two attempts. Escalate to Opus.
execution_record: Straightforward implementation — no debugging needed, all 72 golden cases passed on the first attempt including the circumpolar error case (Moon at -64° latitude, 1600-Jan-1). Fixed star support is threaded through via the existing starname:Option<&str> parameter on rise_trans but not golden-tested (codebase-map riseset note: fixed stars have no TOPOCTR support in rise_trans yet). The gauquelin_sector_geometric method's old imeth 2-5 error arm was replaced with a proper validation error; the new public gauquelin_sector dispatcher sits alongside it.
